title: Agreement of rational and real values
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let a sparse Fourier hypothesis consist of a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with a rational coefficient for each subset. For every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the rational Fourier sum, regarded as a real number, equals the corresponding real Fourier sum.
